description: ArkavoCatalog's shared vectors. `document` is an arkavo.creator-catalog/2 document, the decrypted payload of the catalog envelope; each entry carries its metadata TDF as base64url `metadata`. `index` is the clear entry list a /2 publish sends to the node (PUT /v2/catalogs `index`), without metadata. `metadata` is the decrypted payload of an entry's metadata TDF. `pointer` is an arkavo.catalog-pointer/1, whose catalogSize is the envelope's. Each vector is UTF-8 `text`, or `base64` for bytes that are not valid UTF-8 or carry a byte-order mark. `valid` says whether a reader accepts it.

vectors.name: two entries with the same metadata bytes
two entries with the same payloadHash
a key written with an escape
repeated key, one written with an escape
a /1 field in an entry: title
the 0.9 entry fields: metadataHash and metadataSize
two entries with the same payloadHash
the 0.9 entry fields: metadataHash and metadataSize
